account: It is just after eleven on day 0, and I am at the baker's market stall during my scheduled market walk. So far I have not found clear evidence of anything unusual. Several townspeople said they had no news; others reported seeing the baker carrying wheat at the bakery. I saw the baker stock bread in the stall chest, which seems ordinary business. The baker has now asked whether any upcoming town gatherings might need bread. That could simply be a request for business, not evidence that the baker knows of a gathering. I do not yet know of one. The one unresolved detail in my own schedule is tea at three with an unnamed neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage. The secretary promised to confirm the host's name before my visit. I cannot yet connect that appointment to any unusual activity. My impression that something might be happening without me remains only a suspicion; I do not know who would be involved or what it would be for.
